info.name: VendNet — End-to-End API Tests
info.description:
# VendNet E2E Test Suite

Comprehensive end-to-end tests for all VendNet REST API endpoints.

**Test patterns used:**
- **SUT**: System Under Test comment on every request
- **AAA**: Arrange → Act → Assert comments in test scripts

**Roles tested:**
- Public (unauthenticated)
- Customer
- Operator
- Administrator

**Run with:** `make e2e` or `newman run e2e/VendNet_E2E_Tests.postman_collection.json -e e2e/vendnet-local.postman_environment.json`
